# CambiOS: instructions for coding agents

This file is a pointer. The instructions live in three files at the repository root, and they are the same for every agent:

1. [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): where to start, and the three rules to carry.
2. [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md): the technical contract (conventions, the Stop-and-Ask Gate, required reading per subsystem, the commands).
3. [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md): the process contract (what checks a change, commits, sign-off, review).

Do not rely on a summary of the architecture kept here; one that was kept here went stale. [STATUS.md](../STATUS.md) says what is built.
